finalText:
Migration finished. 12 files still held 36 `db.query(sql, params)` call sites, all converted to `db.execute({ sql, params })`:

- `packages/accounts/src/repo/session.js`, `admin/apiKeyAdmin.js`, `service/teamService.js`
- `packages/billing/src/repo/refund.js`, `service/couponService.js`
- `packages/catalog/src/repo/supplier.js`, `admin/variantAdmin.js`
- `packages/orders/src/repo/shipment.js`, `service/returnService.js`
- `packages/support/src/repo/sla.js`, `admin/macroAdmin.js`
- `packages/analytics/src/repo/cohort.js`

All files pass `node --check`. There are no tests in the repo to run.

Two things I deliberately left alone:

- **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`** still calls `db.query` twice (lines 9, 13). Its header says it's a vendored copy of legacy-orm 2.1.4, replaced wholesale on upgrade with local edits silently lost — so patching it would be undone and isn't safe. Since `lib/db.js` says the driver's next major drops `query`, this needs an upstream fix or a wrapper at the vendor boundary. Say the word and I'll add one.
- **`cache.query(...)`** calls (in ~20 repo files) are a different API on the `cache` handle, not the deprecated db method — untouched.
